owned_action: Do not buy at the current post-results level. Keep cash ready for a pullback back into the preferred entry zone rather than chasing strength.
reason: African Rainbow Minerals still has a constructive catalyst stack after FY2026 headline earnings rose 19% to R3.201bn, PGM operations swung back to profit, the final dividend increased to R7 per share, and Nkomati nickel restart remains a growth catalyst. However, ARI traded around R184.85 on 7 September after reaching roughly R188.84 intraday, moving beyond the prior R179-R184 preferred entry band. The thesis remains intact, but the immediate risk/reward is less attractive after the rebound. Key risks remain weaker iron ore, manganese and coal earnings, large growth capex, and a reversal in PGM prices.
position: Preferred fresh entry remains approximately R179-R184. Reassess if price holds above R188-R190 on strong confirmation rather than chasing.
urgency: Keep cash ready for the next JSE session. Buy only if ARI returns to the preferred entry zone with the thesis intact; otherwise do not chase.
